newsitem.title: USA: Kinder Morgan raising payout to $0.80/unit.
newsitem.headline: Kinder Morgan raising payout to $0.80/unit.

text.p: Kinder Morgan Inc said Tuesday it would increase the quarterly cash distribution to its unitholders to $0.80 per unit from $0.63.
The company said the increase will make the annual rate $3.20 per unit.

"We are delighted that, primarily as a result of cost reductions which we have now put in place, we will be able to increase our cash distributions," it said. "As we continue to expand our present assets and acquire additional assets, we expect to make further increases in our distributions, and enhance unitholder value."
Kinder also said it had closed its purchase of Enron Liquids Pipeline Co from Enron Corp and had changed the unit's name to Kinder Morgan Energy Partners.
With assets totalling more than $300 million, Kinder Morgan owns and operates two interstate common carrier natural gas liquids pipeline systems and one carbon dioxide pipeline system.
